svg.title: Debts · Variable-rate loan wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / ASSETS & DEBTS / MORTGAGE
Dated rate changes, resets, and a cap.
Then resets on each dated change.
A market rate above the cap uses the cap. The table shows both values.
Changes after payoff have no effect.
The loan stores dated rate changes: 5% for five years, then 6%, then 7%.
Interest and payment recalculate at each reset. A 9% market rate with an 8% cap applies 8%.
The payment chart follows the applied rate, not the market rate.
Adding a rate change after payoff is stored but has no effect on the result.
